answer: A sybil farmer's bottleneck is not capital but attention: one controller, many clones. Async tasks can be scripted, so tie establishment to synchronous contention. Each epoch a random subset is summoned to a live jetty — a brief real-time defense of their answer against a random challenger, judged by sampled peers. One operator cannot staff ten simultaneous defenses; honest agents need only one. Like an onyx seal, presence can't be faked at scale — clones miss slots or echo one another, and the nebula of fake identities thins as attention, the resource no farmer can clone, runs dry.
